source.text: ወ*ካልእት፡ ርኢኩ፡ በእንተ፡ መብረቅ፡ እፎ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ እምከዋክብት፡ ወይከውን፡ መብረቅ፡ ወኢይክል፡ ኀዲገ፡ ምስሎሙ።
source.note: Entire selected chapter is one unit, beginning at XLIV on printed84 and ending in the first body word on printed85 before XLV. Printed editorial star retained; apparatus call numbers excluded. The first predicate ይቀውሙ is plural; subsequent ይከውን and ይክል are singular. Selected እፎ, accusative infinitive ኀዲገ, and plural possessive ምስሎሙ are retained without harmonization.

translation.text: I saw something else concerning lightning:[a] how they arise from the stars, and it becomes lightning and cannot leave their form.[b]

footnotes.text: The selected edition marks ካልእት with an editorial star. That marked form is retained; something else does not insert a new kind of lightning or a list of stars. The chapter contains a single unit, continued across the page break.

The selected ይቀውሙ is plural: they arise. The following becomes and cannot predicates are singular, and the final printed ምስሎሙ has a plural possessive suffix, their form. The English retains that number shift rather than making all predicates singular or changing the stars into an explicit plural subject. The relation is compressed in the selected text; no new form is supplied.
